job.jobDescription:
Meta is hiring Full Stack Software Engineers to build innovative social technologies and metaverse experiences. Help us connect billions of people and build the next computing platform.

Job Description:

  • Develop front-end and back-end systems
  • Build products that connect billions of people
  • Work with React, GraphQL, Python, and more
  • Tackle challenging technical problems
  • Shape the future of social technology

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of full-stack development experience
  • Experience with modern web frameworks
  • Strong CS fundamentals
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science
  • Passion for building user-facing products

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with React and GraphQL
  • Mobile development experience
  • VR/AR development background
  • Contributions to open source projects

employer.name: Meta
employer.overview: Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses.
